tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Returns one page or Insights article from projectthunder.com as Markdown: title, URL, summary and the full content. Accepts a full URL (https://www.projectthunder.com/bigcommerce-sap-integration.html) or a path (/bigcommerce-sap-integration.html). A URL on projectthunder.mx, pt.projectthunder.com or projectthunder.asia returns that language's page.

url.description: Full URL or path of the page, as returned by search_site, list_pages or list_articles.

language.description: Optional language: en (default), es, pt or zh. Spanish, Portuguese and Chinese results come from projectthunder.mx, pt.projectthunder.com and projectthunder.asia. The ERP partner directory and partner profiles exist only in English: search and list them without a language (get_page returns them in English). Overrides the language implied by the URL's host.

tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.description: ProjectThunder's phone number, email, contact page, mailing address, where the team works and the topics the contact form covers. Use it when someone wants to talk to ProjectThunder about a project.

language.description: Optional language: en (default), es, pt or zh. Spanish, Portuguese and Chinese results come from projectthunder.mx, pt.projectthunder.com and projectthunder.asia. The ERP partner directory and partner profiles exist only in English: search and list them without a language (get_page returns them in English). Picks the contact page for that language.

tools.name: list_articles
tools.description: Lists the Insights articles (B2B e-commerce, ERP integration, agentic commerce, .NET modernization, .NET MAUI) with publish dates and summaries, newest first. Use get_page to read one. English by default; set language for the Spanish, Portuguese or Chinese site.

language.description: Optional language: en (default), es, pt or zh. Spanish, Portuguese and Chinese results come from projectthunder.mx, pt.projectthunder.com and projectthunder.asia. The ERP partner directory and partner profiles exist only in English: search and list them without a language (get_page returns them in English).

tools.name: list_case_studies
tools.description: Projects from ProjectThunder's portfolio: the client, the platform (Sana Commerce, BigCommerce, DynamicWeb, mobile, AI), the industry, the ERP where the site names it, and what was built. Optionally filter by platform or by a word such as an industry.

platform.description: Optional platform filter, for example "BigCommerce" or "Sana Commerce".

keyword.description: Optional word to match in the industry, client name or description, for example "food" or "distribution".

tools.name: get_erp_partner
tools.description: Returns one listing from the ERP partner directory by slug or name, for example "key-partner-solutions".

partner.description: The partner's slug (from list_erp_partners) or its name.

tools.name: plan_commerce_migration
tools.description: A rollout plan for moving a B2B store from one platform to another around an ERP, from ProjectThunder's published method: the migration paths its pages cover, project phases, a pre-migration checklist, risks with mitigations, which integration pattern fits (real-time, middleware or batch), when each platform is the right target, and the ERP's own caveats when one is named. Every point links to its source page.

from.description: The current platform, for example "Sana 9.3", "Magento 2", "legacy .NET store" or "no store yet".

to.description: Optional target platform: Sana Commerce Cloud, BigCommerce, DynamicWeb or Wardenclyffe.

erp.description: Optional ERP the store must integrate with.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: Lists the pages on projectthunder.com with title, URL, type and one-line summary, in site order. English by default; set language for the Spanish, Portuguese or Chinese site.

type.description: Optional filter: page, article, directory, partner or legal.

language.description: Optional language: en (default), es, pt or zh. Spanish, Portuguese and Chinese results come from projectthunder.mx, pt.projectthunder.com and projectthunder.asia. The ERP partner directory and partner profiles exist only in English: search and list them without a language (get_page returns them in English).

tools.name: scan_website
tools.description: Scans one public website with ProjectThunder's site scan: detects the commerce platform and technologies in use (public BuiltWith data plus the home page), then returns a plain-English summary, what is working, risks that may be costing customers, growth and modernization opportunities, SEO and security notes, AI opportunities, and 0-100 scores. Free; it asks for no name, email or account. Scans the site's home page. Each website gets one fresh scan every 30 days; asking again returns the saved scan with its date. A fresh scan takes 10 to 40 seconds.

url.description: The website to scan, for example "example.com" or "https://www.example.com".

tools.name: assess_erp_commerce_fit
tools.description: For an ERP (and optionally a version and an e-commerce platform), returns how it integrates with Sana Commerce Cloud, BigCommerce, DynamicWeb or Wardenclyffe, version notes such as end-of-support dates, what to settle first, the guides that cover it, and implementation partners in ProjectThunder's ERP partner directory. Every point carries the URL of the page it comes from. Examples: "Business Central", "Dynamics GP 2018", "SAP Business One", "NAV 2009 R2".

erp.description: The ERP, for example "Business Central", "Dynamics NAV", "SAP S/4HANA" or "Epicor Kinetic".

version.description: Optional ERP version or edition, for example "2009 R2", "GP 2018" or "on-premises".

platform.description: Optional e-commerce platform to focus on: Sana Commerce Cloud, BigCommerce, DynamicWeb or Wardenclyffe.

tools.name: list_erp_partners
tools.description: Lists the firms and independent consultants in ProjectThunder's ERP partner directory, optionally filtered by ERP (for example Business Central or Dynamics NAV). Each listing includes location, ERPs, Microsoft credentials, products, services, specialties, industries and links. ProjectThunder premier partners (PremierPartner true) come first, then US-based members.

erp.description: Optional ERP filter by name or slug, for example "Business Central", "business-central" or "Dynamics NAV".

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search the pages on projectthunder.com: services, platform guides (BigCommerce, Sana Commerce, DynamicWeb), ERP integration guides (SAP, Business Central, Dynamics GP, NAV, AX, Epicor), comparisons, Insights articles, the ERP partner directory and partner profiles. Returns the best matches with a snippet. Use get_page to read a result in full. English by default; set language for the Spanish, Portuguese or Chinese site.

query.description: What to look for, in plain words, for example "SAP ECC integration" or "Business Central partner pricing".

type.description: Optional filter: page, article, directory, partner or legal.

language.description: Optional language: en (default), es, pt or zh. Spanish, Portuguese and Chinese results come from projectthunder.mx, pt.projectthunder.com and projectthunder.asia. The ERP partner directory and partner profiles exist only in English: search and list them without a language (get_page returns them in English).
